attr.title: Crusader: No Regret
attr.desc: Reimplementation of the Crusader: No Regret (Origin, 1996) engine in C++/SDL2. Requires the original game data.
attr.inst: Copy the files of your own copy of Crusader: No Regret (English 1.06 or German 1.07: STATIC, USECODE, SOUND, FLICS, REGRET.EXE...), or the CD .iso image, to ports/crusader-no-regret/data. The iso is extracted on first launch.
